text.id: Photo editing: adjust, filters and layers
text.tspan: Photo editing: adjust, filters and layers

text.id: Photoshop-style tools on the same photo: tone and color, filters, retouching, masks and blend modes.
text.tspan: Photoshop-style tools on the same photo: tone and color, filters, retouching, masks and blend modes.

text.id: Adjust tab: brightness, contrast, hue, saturation,
text.tspan: Adjust tab: brightness, contrast, hue, saturation,
temperature, levels, curves. As an Adjustment layer it
is non-destructive: change or delete it any time.

text.id: Properties > Adjust (for the selected picture): quick
text.tspan: Properties > Adjust (for the selected picture): quick
brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, temperature and
tint sliders, and blur. No dialog needed.

text.id: Filter tab: blur, motion blur, sharpen, noise, pixelate,
text.tspan: Filter tab: blur, motion blur, sharpen, noise, pixelate,
vignette, emboss, find edges. Select an area first to
limit the effect to it.

text.id: Retouch tools in the toolbox: Healing, Clone stamp,
text.tspan: Retouch tools in the toolbox: Healing, Clone stamp,
Patch, Dodge / Burn, Liquify. Selections, layer masks,
blend modes and opacity are in the Layer tab.
Original
